item.title: Version 3.10.2
item.description:
neoloopy 3.10.2 (build 64)

A second follow-up to 3.10.0, closing the two canvas gaps noted during the 3.10.1 click-through. Everything in the [3.10.0 notes](3.10.0.md) still applies, including the one-time neoloopy index build after upgrading from 3.9.1.

Scope

  • macOS. The macOS app (DMG and Sparkle update) with the embedded neoloopy CLI and MCP server. Windows, Linux and Android builds are not part of this release, and the iOS app is not part of this cut.

In the app

  • Relation labels keep clear of node bodies. On a dense Graph Model, a relation's type label sat at the exact middle of its curve even when another node's body was there, so the label was drawn under that node or straddled its rim. The label now slides along its own curve to the nearest clear spot, staying within the middle of the curve so it never reaches an arrowhead, and the midpoint control you tap to edit the relation docks where the label is. A label nothing obstructs sits exactly where it did before, and a label with no clear spot anywhere stays at the midpoint.
  • Finishing a note by clicking the canvas keeps the node selected. Typing a note in a node's right pane and clicking the empty canvas saved the note and also dropped the selection, so the pane closed on the node you were working on. The first click now only puts the keyboard down, and the note still saves on that blur. A second click on the empty canvas clears the selection as before, and clicking another node still saves the note and moves the selection to it.
